artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is completely illegible and structurally nonsensical. Letters merge into each other, have inconsistent thickness, and include impossible glyphs (e.g., the 'P' and 'H' shapes are malformed). This is a catastrophic failure of text rendering.
The edges of the letters bleed into the green background slightly, and some characters appear to 'melt' or warp unnaturally, lacking the crisp cut-out or printed edge of a real sign.

The curvature of the sign seems inconsistent with the rigid mounting bracket. The right edge of the sign appears to warp slightly in a way that doesn't perfectly align with the cylindrical pole's perspective.
